Header snapshot from Termux ffmpeg package 8.1.2-5.
libavutil 60.26.102; libavcodec 62.28.102; libavformat 62.12.102.
Headers retain their original license notices, generally LGPL-2.1-or-later.
The adapter dynamically resolves the FFmpeg API already exported by the pinned
libVLC binary; no additional engine binary is bundled. It verifies the exact
AVClass/public-header version before accessing codec structs. Missing symbols
or ABI mismatch select the existing libVLC callback compatibility backend.
Vendored headers: audio-processing/src/main/cpp/third_party/ffmpeg/include.
